results.title: Endel Reviews (2026) | Product Hunt
results.content:
Based on 42 reviews

Review Endel?

Reviewers largely describe Endel as a daily tool for focus, sleep, and winding down, with many saying it helps them work, study, meditate, walk, or block out distracting noise. Its most repeated advantage is that the soundscapes feel adaptive and more useful than static playlists or white-noise apps. A few users also mention helpful extras like AutoPlay, heart-rate awareness, Spotify integration, and family use. The main complaints are setup and onboarding that can feel confusing, some repetitive modes, persistent notification prompts, occasional WearOS glitches, and one view that it does not stand out much from similar apps.

results.title: Endel - Find your focus with Endel
results.content:
The Endel's sound is tuned to 440 hertz. It's the so-called natural order, where the relationships between the intervals are as simple for the brain to process as possible. According to research, it helps reduce the cognitive load in perceiving musical information.

There is a Binaural Beats Scenario in the app. The other sounds don’t use this technology. Binaural waves at the physical level work exclusively in stereo headphones, make sure you wear them when you use the Binaural Beats Scenario.

If you have any issues with the Endel app function or with your subscription or have any questions about Endel, you can contact our support via aform in the app or by reaching out to us: ask@endel.io.
